88602.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. The Dash Shop data set exists, all created today in location ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop, where nothing else is invoiced or clocked this month: work order 1 for customer ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Fleet, Service Advisor ZZAUTOTEST Advisor X, one labor line of 2.00 hours at $100.00 an hour with Tech Time 1.50 and technician ZZAUTOTEST Tech One, a part with Sell Price $50.00, and ZZAUTOTEST Tech One clocked exactly 2.50 hours on it; work order 2 for ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Fleet, Service Advisor ZZAUTOTEST Advisor Y, one labor line of 1.00 hour at $100.00 an hour with Tech Time 1.00 and technicians ZZAUTOTEST Tech One and ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two, a part with Sell Price $160.00, Tech One clocked exactly 0.25 hours and Tech Two exactly 0.75 hours on it. Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: if ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop already exists with exactly this data, reuse it. Otherwise: (a) location: profile icon > Settings > Locations > New Location: Name ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop, the address fields, Timezone, Telephone, Shop Supplies Charge 0 % > Save & Close (if a location with this name already exists, reuse it only if it still matches the precondition). It then appears in your Change Location list; to switch to it, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. (b) staff: profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member, four times: ZZAUTOTEST Tech One and ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two with Role Technician and Time Clock on, ZZAUTOTEST Advisor X and ZZAUTOTEST Advisor Y with Role Service Advisor; each with Location ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop and a Department > Save & Close. Each technician must accept the invitation email and set a password so you can sign in as them in a private window. (c) customers: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save, for ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Fleet and ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Fleet. (d) each work order: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); the New Line window opens: What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician = the technician(s), Labor Rate = EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time and Tech Time as above, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; set Service Advisor in the work order's left panel; on the line click Add Part and add a part with the Sell Price above (it must show In stock, or be ordered and received, before you can invoice). 1. Click Dashboard in the top menu with ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop selected and every tile on its default range.
  2. Read the Revenue headline and its supporting line.
  3. Read the Billing Efficiency headline and its supporting line.
  4. Read the Technician Efficiency headline and its supporting line.
  5. Read the Technician Utilization headline and its supporting line.
  6. Read the Sales by Customer headline.
  7. Click View details on Billing Efficiency and read the Advisor Analysis table rows.
  8. Click View details on Technician Efficiency and read the table rows.

  11. Click View details on Technician Utilization and read the table rows.

Expected results

  • Billing Efficiency reads 85.71% with "3.00 Invoiced / 3.50 Clocked" (labor hours billed 2.00 + 1.00 = 3.00; clocked 2.50 + 0.25 + 0.75 = 3.50; 3.00 ÷ 3.50 × 100 = 85.71).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R2: “Each measure is calculated as defined in the table below.”
  • S3-R2 table: Revenue: “Revenue | Sum of invoice subtotals in the selected range, before any discount and before tax, minus credit memos. Shown to the cent. | Sales report”
  • S3-R2 table: Billing Efficiency: “Billing Efficiency | Invoiced hours divided by worked hours, times 100, for the selected range. | Service Advisor Analysis report”
  • S3-R2 table: Technician Efficiency: “Technician Efficiency | Invoiced technician hours divided by clocked hours, times 100, for the selected range. Each work order line's technician time is split across the technicians who worked it, in proportion to each technician's share of the clocked time on that line. | Technician Efficiency report (Invoiced)”
  • S3-R2 table: Technician Utilization: “Technician Utilization | Work-order hours divided by the sum of work-order hours and internal hours, times 100, for the selected range. | Technician Utilization report”
  • S3-R2 table: Sales by Customer (count): “Sales by Customer (count) | The count of distinct customers with sales in the selected range. | Sales By Customer report”
  • S3-R2 table: At Risk Customers (count): “At Risk Customers (count) | The count of customers whose most recent invoice is at least the selected number of days old, and who also have either two or more lifetime invoices or some revenue in the last twelve months. | None (dashboard-only)”
  • S3-R2 table: ELR (on the Billing Efficiency chart): “ELR (on the Billing Efficiency chart) | Labor sales divided by worked hours, per advisor. | Service Advisor Analysis report”
  • Terminology (worked hours): “the time technicians actually clocked, from their time records.”
  • Terminology (invoiced technician hours): “the technician time recorded on work order lines. Used by Technician Efficiency. This is a different figure from invoiced hours.”
  • Terminology (internal hours): “clocked time not tied to a work order, such as internal tasks.”
  • S3 context note (At Risk): “At Risk Customers has no report, so parity does not apply to it; its formula in this table is the only definition of the measure.”

It then appears in your Change Location list; to switch to it, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. Create nothing in it yet.
88603.custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu and leave every tile on This Month.
  2. Read the Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization headlines and their colour.
  3. Read the Revenue supporting line.
  4. Create one invoiced work order in this location with no clocked time: Customers > New Customer (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST No Clock Fleet) > Save; Work Orders > Create Work Order > that customer and an asset > Save; in New Line: Add Technician, Labor Rate EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time 1 and Tech Time 1, tick Line Approved > Save & Close, and do not let anyone clock in; Story > Update; Complete; Mark Reviewed; Finance > Create Invoice.
  5. Reload the dashboard and read the three ratio headlines again.
  6. Click the arrow icon beside "Billing Efficiency" and read the Service Advisor Analysis figure for the same range.
88603.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With no clocked hours, each of the three ratio tiles shows exactly "-": a single hyphen, in grey. None of them shows "0.00%", "0%" or "n/a".
  • With no revenue, the Revenue tile's supporting line shows the invoice count instead of a parts and labor split (e.g. "0 Invoices").
  • After invoicing a line with technician time but no clocked time, the three ratio headlines still read "-" in grey. Nothing breaks: no error, no endless number, and no blank tile.
  • The report may show its empty figure differently (an empty number with a % sign). That difference alone does not fail this case.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9575 (Story 3, Measure Formulas and Report Parity); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 3 (S3-E3 and its context note). Design canvas board 15_Empty_Design (row 15, approved 7 Oct 2026). Board 15_Empty_Now shows today's build reading "n/a".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-E3: “Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization are each a ratio. When the denominator for the selected range is zero, worked hours, clocked hours, or the sum of work-order and internal hours, the measure has no value for that range. It is not zero, and the tile must not show "0.00%", because no hours recorded and a genuine zero percent are different facts. The same applies to the Revenue tile's parts-versus-labor split when revenue for the range is zero (S4-N2 already gives that tile its fallback supporting line). Inside the Technician Efficiency calculation, a work order line with invoiced technician time but no clocked time contributes no split share rather than an infinite one. The tile headline reads exactly "-", a single hyphen, in grey.”
  • S3-E3 context note: “the matching report renders its own empty cell differently, as an empty number with the percent sign still shown. Bringing the report's empty state into line is deliberately outside this spec, so a difference between the tile and the report in this one case, where neither is showing a figure, is not a failure of the parity rule in S3-R1. S3-R1 governs the figures.”
